messages.subject: Inla crash when dataset is large
parts:
Hi,
I am trying to use INLA to build model on a large dataset, but the error occurs every time,

To stabilise the numerical optimisation:
Minimum value of the -Hessian [-inf]
Strategy for the linear term [Keep]
CPO manual calculation[No]
VB-correction is [Disabled]

inla_build: check Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() : 
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.

Is there anyway to solve it? I already use control.inla = list(diagonal = 100, strategy = 'gaussian', int.strategy = 'eb').

Thank you!
